newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late rubber falls on Palembang deal.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late rubber falls on Palembang deal.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices fell in late trading on Monday following Singaporean buying in Palembang, dealers said.
Dealers said March SIR20 offer prices fell 0.25-0.50 cents/lb to 53.75-54.00 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan, 53.50-53.75 fob Surabaya, Padang and Palembang and at 53.00-53.25 fob Pontianak and Jambi.
Dealers said Singaporean firms bought March SIR20 at 52.50 cents/lb fob Palembang in late trading against 53.00 previously.
